input.name: vn-hn-qi-guide-stone-v1
input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One low cultivation qi conductor marker for the side of a training route. A sturdy squat upright beveled celadon stone slab seated on one compact octagonal ivory stone plinth. The broad front of the slab has one dark petrol recessed channel ending in a simple brass diamond inset. Restrained bronze corner clamps. Solid inactive state, no magic beam, no glow, no particles, no ground ring. Height about a person's knee-to-waist, not a huge monolith; later visible body 64x72 in a 96x96 canvas beside a 64x96 person. Orthographic high-angle three-quarter RPG view about 40 degrees downward; top and front/right faces visible, complete flat contact base, no vanishing point. Compact footprint, no sprawling roots or extra stones. VAN NGOC approved visual direction described in text: decisive dark petrol outlines, clean three-tone cel shading, broad celadon jade and ivory stone planes, restrained aged brass details, warm light from upper left. Crisp illustrated 2D cultivation RPG prop, no photographic 3D rendering, airbrush, bloom, noisy microfiligree, labels, text, letters, watermark, characters, scenery or interface. Reference pixels are NOT transmitted by this tool. Plain solid #FF00FF chromakey background with no ground shadow or magenta reflected light. Isolated complete subject with at least 12 percent clear margin.
